parameters.inputs: (ait_product_subscription/any(s: s/_ait_subscriberid_value eq @{variables('Subscriber')?['ait_subscriberid']}) or ait_pack_product/any(p: p/ait_isactive eq true and p/ait_pack_subscription/any(s: s/_ait_subscriberid_value eq @{variables('Subscriber')?['ait_subscriberid']})))

@if(equals(outputs('Frequency'), 'Daily'), addHours(startOfDay(outputs('Due_from')), outputs('Hour')), if(equals(outputs('Frequency'), 'Weekly'), addHours(addDays(startOfDay(outputs('Due_from')), mod(add(sub(mod(add(outputs('Weekday'), 1), 7), dayOfWeek(outputs('Due_from'))), 7), 7)), outputs('Hour')), addHours(startOfMonth(outputs('Due_from')), outputs('Hour'))))

@if(greater(ticks(outputs('Next_due_base')), ticks(outputs('Due_from'))), outputs('Next_due_base'), if(equals(outputs('Frequency'), 'Daily'), addDays(outputs('Next_due_base'), 1), if(equals(outputs('Frequency'), 'Weekly'), addDays(outputs('Next_due_base'), 7), addHours(startOfMonth(addDays(startOfMonth(outputs('Due_from')), 32)), outputs('Hour')))))

parameters.select: @if(equals(item()?['kind'], 'pack'), concat('ait_pack_product/any(p: p/ait_packid eq ', item()?['id'], ')'), concat('ait_productid eq ', item()?['id']))

parameters.$filter: ait_isactive eq true and (@{if(empty(body('Follow_conditions')), 'ait_productid eq null', join(body('Follow_conditions'), ' or '))})

parameters.inputs: @{if(not(equals(coalesce(triggerBody()?['stamp'], ''), outputs('Stamp'))), 'This card is out of date: your settings changed after it was sent. Nothing was saved. Type /mysettings for a new card.', if(or(less(outputs('Lookahead'), 1), greater(outputs('Lookahead'), 24), less(outputs('Critical'), 1), greater(outputs('Critical'), 24)), 'Look-ahead and critical window must be whole numbers from 1 to 24. Nothing was saved.', if(and(greater(length(body('To_add')), 0), greater(outputs('Cap'), 0), greater(length(body('Count_after')?['value']), outputs('Cap'))), concat('That would bring you to ', length(body('Count_after')?['value']), ' products, and the limit is ', outputs('Cap'), '. Nothing was saved. Pick fewer packs or products.'), '')))}

@or(greater(length(body('To_add')), 0), greater(length(body('To_remove')), 0), outputs('Schedule_changed'), not(equals(outputs('Lookahead'), variables('Subscriber')?['ait_lookaheadmonths'])), not(equals(outputs('Critical'), variables('Subscriber')?['ait_criticalwindowmonths'])), not(equals(outputs('Pause'), outputs('Was_paused'))), not(equals(outputs('Send_empty'), outputs('Was_send_empty'))))

inputs: @{if(not(empty(outputs('Problem'))), outputs('Problem'), if(outputs('Changed'), 'Saved.', 'Nothing to save: the card matches your current settings.'))}

@{if(or(not(empty(outputs('Problem'))), not(outputs('Schedule_changed'))), '', concat('Digests now arrive ', if(equals(outputs('Frequency'), 'Daily'), 'daily', if(equals(outputs('Frequency'), 'Monthly'), 'monthly on the 1st', concat('weekly on ', createArray('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday')[outputs('Weekday')]))), ' at ', formatNumber(outputs('Hour'), '00'), ':00 UTC. Next one: ', formatDateTime(outputs('Next_due'), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' UTC.'))}
@{if(or(not(empty(outputs('Problem'))), equals(outputs('Pause'), outputs('Was_paused'))), '', if(outputs('Pause'), 'Digests paused. Your subscriptions are kept.', 'Digests resumed.'))}

@{if(or(not(empty(outputs('Problem'))), equals(outputs('Send_empty'), outputs('Was_send_empty'))), '', if(outputs('Send_empty'), 'Scheduled digests now arrive even when there are no new items.', 'Scheduled digests with no new items are now skipped.'))}
